LLVM fuzzer harness for fd_ar_read_init and fd_ar_read_next on memory files.

# Purpose
This file defines a libFuzzer entry point for testing the `fd_ar` archive reader. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) sets up the runtime, disables log backtraces, and registers `fd_halt` for process shutdown. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) wraps the input buffer with `fmemopen`, initializes archive reading with `fd_ar_read_init`, and calls `fd_ar_read_next` several times on the same stream to exercise the parser with arbitrary data.
